verdict.rationale: Derivative ecosystems are a fair axis for any AI model, so the story applies, but the pack has no evidence of community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations of Gemini on public hubs, nor any attribution of official versus unofficial derivatives. The first-party supervised fine-tuning service is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a real derivative ecosystem exists around the model — community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations on public hubs — with clear attribution of what is and is not official
